2024_149_sep_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) report for September 2024, carried on the November 19, 2024 Board of Education agenda, itemizes every card charge posted to district budget units, with each line showing the transaction date and merchant, the journal-entry description "SEP 2024 PCARD EXP," the budget unit, the account code, and either a transaction amount or a credit. Charges are dated from 8/27/2024 through 9/25/2024 and run 44 pages, each footer dated 11/14/2024. The report closes with a Subtotal of 350,803.39 in charges against 7,375.70 in credits and a Total Expenses line of 343,427.69. The single largest charge is 9,875.00 to BAILEY POTTE on 9/5/2024 against budget unit 101590113350500, account 5110.

**Document and format**

Each transaction description combines the posting date and a truncated merchant name (for example "9/17/2024-SECURLY  INC"), and every line carries the identical journal-entry description "SEP 2024 PCARD EXP." Transaction dates run from 8/27/2024 through 9/25/2024. The final page closes with a Subtotal line of 350,803.39 in the Transaction Amount column and 7,375.70 in the Credits column, followed by a "Total Expenses" line of 343,427.69.
